covers: Thursday 26 November JSE session and overnight (US markets closed for Thanksgiving); prices as of the 26 November close
headline: Tiger Brands jumps 11.4% on results as miners lift the JSE; rand steady near R17.53 and gold up 1.7% to about $3,594 ahead of tonight's Moody's and S&P reviews
summary: Results drove Thursday's JSE session: Tiger Brands rose 11.4% to R297.50 and Alexforbes 8.1%, while platinum and gold miners gained 5-7% as platinum rose 3.3% (LRC Stock Scanner, 26 Nov 2026). US markets were shut for Thanksgiving and reopen today for a shortened session, so there is no new Wall Street close to report. The rand ended little changed at about R17.53 per dollar and gold gained 1.66% to about $3,594 an ounce (LRC Forex & Commodities scan, 26 Nov 2026), with the Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late tonight.

items.title: Tiger Brands up 11.4% after FY2026 results: normalised HEPS +10.5%, margin and ROIC targets raised
items.summary: Tiger Brands closed at R297.50, up 11.4% on 26 Nov 2026 (LRC Stock Scanner). Normalised continuing HEPS rose 10.5% to 2,087c on 4.5% volume growth, operating margin widened to 12.6% from 11.1% and the total dividend rose 5.2% to 1,729c; management expects FY2027 to stay tough (SENS, 26 Nov 2026).
items.source: Tiger Brands SENS via Listcorp, 26 Nov 2026

items.title: Wall Street was closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving; shortened session today
items.summary: No new US closing levels since Wednesday 25 Nov, when the Dow ended up 0.33% after erasing a 1,100-point loss while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower (Motley Fool, 25 Nov 2026). US stock markets reopen today, Friday 27 Nov, with an early close.

items.title: Miners and results lift JSE stocks; platinum shares up 5-7%
items.summary: Pan African Resources rose 6.9%, Sibanye-Stillwater 5.9%, Impala Platinum 5.3% and Harmony 4.9%; Anglo American gained 3.2% and Naspers 1.9% after Wednesday's post-results sell-off (LRC Stock Scanner, JSE close 26 Nov 2026).
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 26 Nov 2026

items.title: Alexforbes up 8.1% as interim continuing HEPS rises 16%
items.summary: Continuing HEPS rose 16% to 30.3c and operating income 10% to R2.57bn; the interim dividend was held at 24c (SENS, 26 Nov 2026). The share closed at R7.84, up 8.1% (LRC Stock Scanner, 26 Nov 2026).

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late tonight
items.summary: Both agencies are scheduled to publish reviews of South Africa's credit rating late on Friday 27 Nov, after Wednesday's hotter-than-expected 8.1% producer inflation print (Stats SA, 26 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand flat near R17.53; gold up 1.7% to about $3,594, platinum up 3.3%
items.summary: USD/ZAR ended at 17.53 (-0.06%), EUR/USD at 1.097 and GBP/USD at 1.311. Gold rose 1.66% to $3,594 an ounce, platinum 3.3% to $1,282, copper 1.95% to $5.44/lb and WTI crude 1.54% to $84.97 a barrel (LRC Forex & Commodities scan, Yahoo Finance daily prices, 26 Nov 2026).

items.title: Tiger Brands (LRC rating HOLD): results beat on volumes; share now above the LRC price target range
items.summary: After the 11.4% jump to R297.50 the scanner keeps the rating at HOLD; the LRC price target midpoint is about R218, roughly 27% below the price, which caps the rating despite a strong score (LRC Stock Scanner, 26 Nov 2026).
items.source: Tiger Brands SENS via Listcorp, 26 Nov 2026

items.title: Life Healthcare (LRC rating BUY) up 3.8%: normalised EPS +9.5%, dividend +14.3%
items.summary: Normalised EPS rose 9.5% to 109.8c on flat revenue of R25.5bn as margins widened; the dividend rose 14.3% to 40c and the group targets about 5% revenue growth in FY2027 (SENS, 26 Nov 2026). The share closed at R12.66 (LRC Stock Scanner, 26 Nov 2026).
items.source: Life Healthcare SENS via Listcorp, 26 Nov 2026

items.title: Oceana (LRC rating BUY) up 1.1%: HEPS +50.5%, but Lucky Star shortage to last into 2027
items.summary: HEPS rose 50.5% to 850.3c on strong US fishmeal and hake while revenue fell 4.2% to R9.6bn; total dividend 430c (SENS, 26 Nov 2026). The share closed at R72.43 (LRC Stock Scanner, 26 Nov 2026).
